results.title: Course Descriptions - Academic Catalogs
results.content: | [ART 105 - History of Western Art II](https://catalog.southernct.edu/undergraduate/courses.html#) ## ART 105 - History of Western Art II Painting, sculpture, and architecture from the Renaissance to contemporary times, including works by Botticelli, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Caravaggio, Monet, and Picasso, examined in social, historical, and aesthetic context. | [ART 371 - Curriculum Development in Art Education](https://catalog.southernct.edu/undergraduate/courses.html#) ## ART 371 - Curriculum Development in Art Education This course provides students with the foundations for developing curriculum in art education through an in-depth investigation of past theory as well as contemporary frameworks, while exploring diverse contexts for developing art education curriculum that include multicultural, visual culture, and community-based art educators, as well as museum collaborations. | [SWK 382 - Social Work Practice with Older Adults](https://catalog.southernct.edu/undergraduate/courses.html#) ## SWK 382 - Social Work Practice with Older Adults Introduces students to the experience of growing older, including concepts related to the biological and physiological context of aging and health status; psychological context of aging and mental health; and the social context of aging, including family, social supports, the intersectionality of age with race, ethnicity, class, gender, and sexuality; and social and health care policies.
